business_problem: Yingkang Life needed to move agents from demonstrations into reliable production for a health ecosystem serving more than 13,000 employees. It needed stable quality, scale, cost control, auditability, and clear permission boundaries so agents could participate safely in medical and organizational workflows.
solution_summary: Yingkang Life built Xiaoying Agent OS on Alibaba Cloud's Agentic Cloud foundation, using AgentCore for agent execution and governance and AgentLoop for observation and optimization. The AI Gateway handles authentication and routing; Bailian provides multimodal foundation models; Supabase, APIs, and MCP connect business systems, data, and tools; and IAM establishes user-agent identity, least privilege, and revocable authorization. AgentCore supplies isolated sandboxes, multi-tenant workspaces, orchestration, and release gates, while AgentLoop traces tasks and feeds failures and successful runs into evaluation and review. Agents use data and capability maps to collaborate in approved applications, with human review, rollback, and audit trails. The platform is used as a shared employee AI entry point for office work, application creation, and coding.

data_flow: Business information and tools connect through Supabase, APIs, and MCP; requests pass through the AI Gateway to models and agents running in AgentCore. AgentLoop records traces and evaluation results, while IAM constrains access and human approval gates changes before release.
integration_points: Business systems through APIs and MCP
Employee office, application-building, and coding workflows
business_outcome: The platform became a shared AI entry point for over 13,000 employees. In nearly three months, employees created 465 AI-native applications; the company estimates model-routing improvements can reduce model-call costs by 30.97%.
metrics: 7,721 high-quality conversation scenarios accumulated in nearly 3 months
architecture_clues: Agent execution uses millisecond-level isolated sandboxes and remote workspaces
Release gates support human confirmation, rollback, and audit
User and agent identities use least-privilege authorization and dynamic credentials
